name: VS
recent: V.S. Industry Berhad 近期提交了最多占已发行股本10%的员工认股计划（ESOS）上市申请，同时有一宗重大诉讼在进行中。公司截至2026年7月31日的季度营收环比增长24.2%、同比增长16.3%，但仍录得净亏损2196万令吉，净亏损率收窄至2.2%。
notable: 最多占已发行普通股10%，并已于2026年11月20日向Bursa Securities提交上市申请。
有一宗重大诉讼（MATERIAL LITIGATION）公告。
非执行董事Wong Cheer Feng于2026年10月多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
risks: 公司有一宗重大诉讼在进行中。
截至2026年7月31日季度仍录得净亏损2196万令吉。
earnings: 截至2026年7月31日的季度营收为9.986亿令吉，环比增长24.2%、同比增长16.3%；净亏损2196万令吉，净亏损率为2.2%，较上一季度的4.1%净亏损率有所收窄。

recent_en: V.S. Industry Berhad recently submitted the listing application for an ESOS of up to 10% of its issued shares and has an ongoing material litigation. For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue rose 24.2% QoQ and 16.3% YoY, but the company still recorded a net loss of MYR21.96 million with net margin narrowing to -2.2%.
notable_en: Proposed ESOS of up to 10% of issued ordinary shares, with the listing application submitted to Bursa Securities on 20 November 2026.
A material litigation announcement was made.
Non-Executive Director Wong Cheer Feng acquired shares in the open market multiple times in October 2026.
risks_en: The company has an ongoing material litigation.
The proposed ESOS may issue new shares of up to 10% of issued share capital, potentially causing dilution.
The quarter ended 31 July 2026 still recorded a net loss of MYR21.96 million.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR998.6 million, up 24.2% QoQ and 16.3% YoY; net loss was MYR21.96 million with a net margin of -2.2%, narrower than the previous quarter's -4.1%.
